WITH execution_groups AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase AS channel,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  channel,
  avg_filled_quantity,
  distinct_order_count,
  1.0 * distinct_order_count / SUM(distinct_order_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_orders
FROM execution_groups;

assumptions.assumption: The denominator is the sum of distinct linked orders counted within each channel; orders have one orderbase value and therefore belong to only one group.
